title: Kind of People You Find in Sumo Islamabad Part 1
body: A man circling the F-6 Markaz car park for the fourth time, already fifteen minutes late to his own lunch, still refusing to just valet like a normal person. A table of aunties who ordered in Urdu, got served in English, and are now gossiping loud enough for two tables to eavesdrop for free. An all-girls group taking forty photos of one roll before anyone touches it, each one for a different platform. A girl ordering the spiciest thing on the menu on her literal first sushi order, drinking the whole welcome drink in one go like a dare, eyes watering, insisting she's "actually so fine." The whole restaurant clapping because staff randomly started singing happy birthday to a table that clearly wasn't expecting to perform surprise for an audience.
caption:
Tag the one who ordered the spiciest roll to look tough and is now crying quietly 😭
